steps.js: (async () => { await window.__gitgood.actions.addLocalRepository(__REPO_PATH__); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); const before = window.__gitgood.store.get().status.branch.name; const branch = window.__gitgood.store.get().branches.find((b) => b.kind === 'local' && b.name === 'feature'); if (!branch) return JSON.stringify({ error: 'feature branch not found', before }); await window.__gitgood.actions.checkoutBranch(branch); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); const after = window.__gitgood.store.get().status.branch.name; return JSON.stringify({ before, after }); })()
